sources.label: Morphe patches for Keyflow (com.angkin.keyflow) 1.5.8 - PairIP, signer-identity,
sources.author: Keyflow
patch_list: Neuters PairIP license verification using fingerprint matching (version-robust).
Forces all Pro features enabled using fingerprint matching (version-robust for method name changes).
Forces the app's signer identity to match the original publisher certificate (fingerprint-based, version-robust).
Neuters PairIP license verification so the app runs without a valid license.
Forces all Pro features enabled and replaces the Google Play confirmation with a fake success, so ad surfaces never appear.
Forces the app's signer identity to match the original publisher certificate.
